text:
elaine: Pushed a new Figma of the compact create/rotate/revoke flows — want feedback on density + a11y copy. Link: https://figma.com/rdw/compact-keyflow

mike: Nice! First glance — the create modal feels cramped when the permissions matrix is open. Could we collapse rule descriptions by default? :point_up:

anna: For onboarding, we should default to 'read-only' for API keys created via quick-create. Lower blast radius. Thoughts?

raj: Implementation note: collapsing rows is fine, but expanding will shift modal height a lot on smaller screens. Might need an internal scroll region instead of entire modal resizing.

samira: Accessibility: when the secret is revealed we need an aria-live announce and a clear label on the show/hide button. Current mock says "Show" which is ambiguous for screen readers. Suggest: `Show secret for copying` and `Hide secret` as accessible names.

jo: Agree with Samira. Also propose an inline helper text: "This secret is shown only once" — but it needs to be programmatic (aria-describedby) so screen readers get it immediately.

toby: Small front-end nit: the copy-to-clipboard button should have `aria-label="Copy API key"` and show a transient toast with `role=alert`. That covers non-visual feedback too.

nate: Security: recommend adding a small banner in the empty state reminding users about least privilege. Example copy: "Create keys with minimal permissions. Rotate often." Short and punchy.

elaine: On empty-state layout I experimented with two options — full-info card vs compact CTA. Which is more discoverable for teams new to keys?

mike: Full-info card for first-time users, compact for power users. Maybe detect org age/usage and show variant? Or just progressive disclosure: help expanded by default for new orgs.

anna: Also a soft-delete flow for revoke: let users undo within 30s. We already have rollback across platform; same affordance here reduces accidental outages. Copy: "Key revoked — undo?" with small link.

samira: Also ensure revoke modal has focus trap and that cancel restores focus to the original key row. Keyboard users need predictable focus flow.

raj: We'll add focus management, and for the undo we'll send a background request that marks key state as 'pending_revoke' and then finalizes. That buys us the 30s window.

toby: For the permissions matrix, can we show condensed chips instead of long labels? e.g., `embeddings`, `generate`, `admin` — hover or screen-reader only full label. Keeps the row height down.

samira: If using chips, ensure the full permission name is in the accessible name. Screen readers should not hear truncated labels.

jo: UX copy proposal for rotate modal title: "Rotate API key — prepare dependent services". Short body: "Rotating invalidates the current key immediately. Update any callers before you rotate, or use 'Create & swap' to stage a new key."

nate: Strong +1 for explicit danger copy. Maybe add a checkbox for "I understand rotating will break running services" for orgs with >100 keys to force pause.

elaine: Quick QA checklist I'm adding to the mock: keyboard nav, aria-live on reveal, toast role=alert for copy, focus restore after modal close, undo affordance for revoke, responsive scroll region. Anything missing?

mike: Add contrast checks for the permission chips — the condensed design lowers color area and could fail AA.

samira: Also test with NVDA/VoiceOver on mobile small widths. Compact layouts often mask focus outlines.

deploy-bot: CI test run queued for branch `feat/compact-keyflow-a11y` — 12 tests queued, will report back.

elaine: Great, thanks all. I'll update Figma with the a11y label changes and two empty-state variants (full card + compact). Will ping again when updated. :sparkles:
